question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a orange present, Claire has a teal present, Dave has a blue present, and Eve has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Dave has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) orange present
(C) teal present
(D) blue present
(E) silver present
solution:
Gift colors in fixed order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: purple | orange | teal | blue | silver
1. Alice ↔ Dave: blue | orange | teal | purple | silver
2. Alice ↔ Eve: silver | orange | teal | purple | blue
3. Dave ↔ Alice: purple | orange | teal | silver | blue
4. Dave ↔ Claire: purple | orange | silver | teal | blue
5. Dave ↔ Eve: purple | orange | silver | blue | teal
Dave has the blue present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
